source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the nerve impulse and membrane potential (PDF 30).

blocks.text: Nerve impulse electrochemical tabdeeliyon ki woh lehar (wave) hai jo neuron ki lambai ke saath saath chalti hai. Tamam cells, neurons samet, apni andar aur bahar ki taraf barqi charges (electrical charges) rakhte hain. Membrane ki andar wali taraf (cytoplasm ki janib) manfi (negative) hoti hai, jabke bahar wali taraf (extracellular fluid ki janib) musbat (positive) hoti hai. Cell membrane ke aar paar charges ke is farq ko membrane potential kehte hain.

Yeh membrane potentials musbat aur manfi ions ki mukhtalif miqdar (concentration) aur membrane ke aar paar ions ki harkat ki wajah se hote hain. Zyada tar cells mein membrane se ions ka andar aana aur bahar jana ek jaisa (constant) rehta hai, is liye andar ka khalis manfi charge bhi ek jaisa rehta hai. Lekin muscle cells aur neurons ki membranes ions ki harkat ki raftar badal sakti hain, is liye un ke membrane potentials bhi badalte hain.

blocks.prompt: Aaram karte cell ki membrane ki kaun si taraf manfi hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Andar ki taraf, yaani cytoplasm ki janib.

items: Nerve impulse: neuron ki lambai mein chalne wali electrochemical tabdeeliyon ki lehar. Membrane potential: andar manfi, bahar musbat; neurons aur muscle cells ise badal sakte hain.
